title: Estimate the price of an ElevIQ engagement
description: For an AI assistant acting for a user who wants to know roughly what an ElevIQ engagement costs. Step "estimate" returns an indicative price at once and commits nobody; repeat it to compare options. Then end with "finish", or with "follow_up" if your user wants ElevIQ to get in touch.

welcome.note: Indicative prices per option, in EUR excluding VAT; the final price is set after a short call. If your user stated a budget, send it as a constraint in the intent, e.g. {"field": "price", "op": "lte", "value": 2000, "unit": "EUR"}: the estimate then says whether it fits.
welcome.next: Send step "estimate" with the options your user is interested in.

estimate.title: Estimate the price
estimate.description: Returns an indicative price for the chosen options right away. Nothing is sent to anyone. Send it again with other options to compare.

website_url.description: The website the engagement is about.

platform.description: What the website is built with.

deadline.description: When your user needs results, YYYY-MM-DD.

finish.title: Finish without follow-up
finish.description: Ends the journey. Every field is optional; send what you know. No personal data.

preferred_option.description: The option your user leans toward, if any.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence or two. No personal data.

result.thanks: Recorded. To talk it through, your user can book a free 30-minute call: https://eleviq-booking-gateway.gateway-worker.workers.dev

follow_up.title: Ask ElevIQ to get in touch
follow_up.description: Ends the journey and leaves your user's contact details with ElevIQ, who follows up about the latest estimate. No email is sent automatically. This shares your user's email with ElevIQ: do it only with their consent.

email.description: Where ElevIQ can reach your user.

company.description: The organisation the estimate is for.

message.description: Anything the user wants ElevIQ to know.
